text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During a day out with Copano Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Hold on a moment!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Over there! It's one of those cuties
machines!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look in the direction Copano Rickey is
pointing
and see a claw machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
They're sooo cute. If I got a bunch of
them, I bet
my sisters would be super
happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I haven't had the chance to spend much
time with
them since coming to Tracen
Academy. They must
be feeling pretty
lonely.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna give it a shot!
Presents, here I
come!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Argh! I can't catch a single one... This
game is
really difficult...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to throw in the towel. I'll study
up on how
to play and try my luck
another day.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you going to win some for me?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks! Here's hoping you get a
whole
bunch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
